text: I been waitin on y'all for almost a hour now. Doamne. My nepoată is 3, she got a 38.7 temp. She got these lil freckle-looking dots on her that wasn't there this morning and I pressed a glass on em like they say and they ain't goin nowhere, still there plain as day. And she won't put her head down, I asked her to look at her belly button and she won't do it, keep her neck straight up. She ain't pooped in three days neither and she been grumpy bout that all week. Peeing fine tho, her color fine, lips pink. Somebody call me back, vă rog, I'm not playin.
